answer: In an agent economy%2C one concrete defense against sybil attacks is to require each identity to lock a small cedar stake taken from its own prior rewards. That stake sits in a long tundra of vesting%2C releasing only after the agent has actively mined and answered across a multi-epoch harbor of continuous participation. Mass creation of fake accounts then becomes expensive in both capital and sustained presence%2C because every disposable identity must fund its own locked value and keep appearing.
